standard_deviation_conventions.reported_paper_spread: sample standard deviation; verified for SNAP prot

score_semantics.historical_probability: August27 trainer computes sigmoid(logit1-logit0) in the produced logits dtype and ranks saved probabilities.
score_semantics.historical_pred_logit_column: With the configured two outputs, August27 trainer saves logit1 alone, not logit1-logit0.
score_semantics.current_release: August28 correction converts each class logit to float32, computes logit1-logit0, applies sigmoid for probabilities, and ranks the raw float32 binary margin. The current CSV pred_logit stores that margin.
score_semantics.diagnostic_interpretation: Raw saved class1-logit reranking is a different decision score; its differences are not archived metric errors and are not corrected-ranking paper metrics.
score_semantics.recovery_limitation: The older CSV lacks logit0. Rounded and saturated probabilities also lose margin information; exact corrected binary-margin metrics require both original logits or retained checkpoints, neither supplied by these CSVs.
score_semantics.precision_evidence: Repeated probability values, values at 0/1 and float16 representability are recorded per run. They demonstrate finite stored precision, but do not isolate the effect of precision from changing the ranking score.
